source.control_strategy: breakpoint every instruction of the spine body; each stop closes the previous callee and opens the next; terminate by iteration count
source.emulator: bundled Dolphin 2606-97 (dolphin/Dolphin.exe), Null video, CPU only
source.game_state: cold boot (no savestate), Null video backend, CPU only, no pad injection
exclusions: memory deltas are watch-set-scoped: only the declared owned regions are diffed, a full MEM1 diff cannot run at frame rate over GDB-RSP
console stack addresses are excluded (the wasm module has its own linear stack)
K is not owner-approved (I3's gate requires owner-approved K)

a non-finite float argument is carried boxed and bit-exact, but JS canonicalises NaN, so a boxed NaN can only be compared as "both are NaN" -- the payload bits are not observable through the wasm/JS import boundary
